guard_guest() {

  [[ -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || return 125

  IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || return 125
  IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || return 125
  [[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || return 125
  (( UID == EUID )) || return 125
  if (( EUID == 0 )); then
    mapfile -t uid_rows </proc/self/uid_map || return 125
    (( ${#uid_rows[@]} == 1 )) || return 125
    read -r inside outside length extra <<<"${uid_rows[0]}" || return 125
    [[ $inside == 0 && $outside == 2000 && $length == 1 && -z $extra ]] || return 125
  else
    (( EUID == 2000 )) || return 125
  fi
  virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || return 125
  [[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || return 125
}
guard_guest || { printf 'refusing non-fixture guest\n' >&2; exit 125; }
[[ $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
echo secret > secret.txt; chmod 644 secret.txt
cat > prof <<'EOP'
profile w5mig-confine flags=(attach_disconnected) {
  /** rwmix,
  deny /tmp/parity-case/secret.txt r,
}
EOP
/usr/sbin/apparmor_parser -r prof || { echo load-failed; exit 90; }
echo "unconfined-read=$(ns spawn none /usr/bin/cat secret.txt 2>&1)"
echo "confined-profile=$(ns spawn lsm w5mig-confine none /usr/bin/cat /proc/self/attr/current 2>&1)"
ns spawn lsm w5mig-confine none /usr/bin/cat secret.txt >denied.out 2>denied.err; echo "confined-read nonzero=$([[ $? != 0 ]] && echo yes || echo no) denied=$([[ $(< denied.err) == *'Permission denied'* ]] && echo yes || echo no) leaked=$([[ -s denied.out ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "caller-still-unconfined=$(< /proc/self/attr/current)"
/usr/sbin/apparmor_parser -R prof; echo "unload rc=$?"
cases.stdout:
unconfined-read=secret
confined-profile=w5mig-confine (enforce)
confined-read nonzero=yes denied=yes leaked=no
caller-still-unconfined=unconfined
unload rc=0
